identity.philosophy: The Digital Press - Swiss Utility. Absolute clarity, tactile precision, zero fluff.
principles: Fusion: Digital speed meets Analog paper tactile feel.
Content: The user's files are the hero.
Negative Space: Radical emptiness to focus attention.
Contrast: Sharp black on white. No gray zones.

DropZone.style: border-2 border-dashed border-neutral-200 rounded-xl bg-neutral-50/50 transition-colors duration-200 ease-out hover:border-blue-400 hover:bg-blue-50/30
DropZone.instruction: Use the texture_url as a subtle background image with extremely low opacity (0.03) on the drop zone to give it a paper feel.

Button.primary: h-12 px-8 rounded-lg bg-blue-600 text-white font-medium hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
Button.secondary: h-12 px-8 rounded-lg bg-white border border-neutral-200 text-neutral-900 hover:bg-neutral-50 transition-colors
Button.icon_only: h-8 w-8 p-0 rounded-full hover:bg-neutral-100 text-neutral-500 hover:text-red-600 transition-colors

FileCard.style: relative group aspect-[3/4] rounded-lg border border-neutral-200 bg-white overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all
FileCard.remove_btn: absolute top-2 right-2 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity bg-white/90 hover:bg-red-50 text-neutral-500 hover:text-red-600 rounded-full p-1.5 shadow-sm

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise or grain if possible, but keep it minimal.

motion.philosophy: Invisible Utility. No decoration. Only feedback.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is #0A0A0A on #FFFFFF. Muted text must be #6B7280 or darker.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements.
accessibility.aria: All drag zones and buttons must have aria-labels.

assets.icons: Use lucide-react. Icons: UploadCloud, FileImage, X, FileDown, Loader2

images.description: Subtle white paper texture for dropzone background

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Implement the 'DropZone' as the central hero element.
2. Use the 'texture_url' as a background-image for the DropZone with opacity-5 to create a tactile paper feel.
3. Ensure the 'Convert to PDF' button is prominent and only active when files are present.
4. The file list should look like a grid of polaroids or contact sheets.
5. STRICTLY NO DECORATIVE ANIMATIONS. Only hover states and loading spinners.
7. Ensure mobile responsiveness: DropZone becomes smaller, Grid becomes 2 columns.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts; use the 'Swiss Utility' grid.
Create depth through subtle borders and ultra-soft shadows.
